prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: hi-res pixel-art game sprite strip, exactly six frames for a 2D anime arena fighter.
Primary request: Draw exactly six separate full-body frames of Killua in chronological order in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid (row 1 = f0, f1, f2; row 2 = f3, f4, f5), on a 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Equal square cells, wide clean gaps, one complete pose per cell, no crossing gaps.
Subject: Killua, slim wiry pale 13-year-old, serious anime proportions about six heads tall and not chibi; messy fluffy spiky silver-white hair with cool lavender-grey shadows, soft pointed tufts in all directions and short bangs; narrow sharp face, upturned blue cat eyes, thin brows; loose long-sleeved purple shirt, wide loose dark navy rolled collar, white undershirt visible at cuffs and below the shirt hem, baggy dark navy shorts above knees, bare shins, purple high-top sneakers with white soles, white toe caps and laces. Keep exact identity, outfit, colors, proportions and scale consistent. Faces screen-right in 3/4 view, both eyes visible. His character design allows short natural pale claws on charge poses.
Composition/framing: six equal cells in 3 columns x 2 rows, centered complete figures from hair to soles, consistent character size, same ground line and sole baseline. Hard pixel art on a consistent grid, crisp hard edges, no antialiasing, blur, gradients or dithering.
Pose sequence:
f0 GATHER: deep hunched wide crouch on balls of feet, knees bent, torso folded forward, chin tucked, narrowed eyes fierce; both arms crossed low in front of lower chest/upper waist, hands tense with crooked curled fingers, shoulders hunched; hair and clothes at rest.
f1 RELEASE: snap open to low crouched power pose; chest opens/lifts, head comes up, both arms flung down and outward at sides, elbows slightly bent, hands open with spread crooked fingers and short natural claws; fierce shout, teeth and one small pointed canine. Hair bristles upward; sleeves and shirt hem flick upward.
f2 HOLD a, f3 HOLD b, f4 HOLD c, f5 HOLD d: exact same low crouched pose/body placement as f1. Register loop tightly: identical shoe/foot pixels and baseline, knees, hip line, leg pose; head center and hand positions shift at most 1-2 pixels. Only subtle breath/shout changes in chest/shoulders and fingers plus four distinct upward hair-tuft and gently lifting sleeve/hem silhouettes. f2 inhale; f3 chest/shoulders rise 1-2px and mouth widest; f4 forearms/fingers quiver 1px; f5 shoulders settle 1-2px and flow back into f2. No stance/body drift.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta.
Constraints: no electricity, lightning, aura, sparks, steam, dust, glow or effects; no props, accessories, labels, text, watermark, extra limbs or duplicate figures. Claws no longer than half a finger.
